|lore=Warrant Officer Bachenkall is typical of the many graduates of the Imperial Training Academy on Raithal. The sector naval school trains pilots in capital starship helm tactics.
|game_text=Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Devastator deploys -2 here. While piloting a Star Destroyer, it is hyperspeed +1 and opponent must first use 1 Force (if possible) to draw a card for battle destiny here. Once per game, may deploy Imperial Pilot here from outside your deck.
|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Warrant Officer Bachenkall]] (version 1 of 2). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published. The current text is [[Warrant Officer Bachenkall (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).

Devastator deploys -2 here. While piloting a Star Destroyer, it is hyperspeed +1 and opponent must first use 1 Force (if possible) to draw a card for battle destiny here. Once per game, may deploy Imperial Pilot here from outside your deck.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Warrant Officer Bachenkall (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 27 release sheet<ref name="sheet27-20261013">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-27.pdf Virtual Set 27 release sheet] (PDF, 6 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, October 2026”; file created 13 October 2026). Released with [[Virtual Set 27]] (9 October 2026); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 1, file created 13 October 2026: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Devastator deploys -2 here. While piloting a Star Destroyer, it is hyperspeed +1 and opponent must first use 1 Force (if possible) to draw a card for battle destiny here. Once per game, may deploy Imperial Pilot here from outside your deck.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Warrant Officer Bachenkall]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Warrant Officer Bachenkall]] (published 9 October 2026) as a printable slip under the label “•Warrant Officer Bachenkall”, pixel for pixel the same except that the picture area is left blank (white), so the slip can be laid over the picture of the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Imperial Helmsman]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
